title: All 40 original Freestyle venues now available publicly
summary: Fury Remastered’s public app now unlocks all 40 source venue families in Freestyle: eight ENV, six FREE, eight NAT, sixteen SX, Training, and Coonce Arena. A continuous Chromium sweep loaded and drove all 40 from the public deployment.
details: The map app passed main CI/deploy at 3b08d61 (run 38487888220). Its separately published R2 package validated 500 objects with 41 changes and a manifest of 147 runtime entries. Public hash verification on furyremastered.com and the Workers origin matched 44 authored static files and 499 served content objects.

All 40 public venue routes became ready and drove with zero unsupported scenery meshes and no JavaScript or WebGL errors. The public menu/controller/touch regression passed, as did six Sausalito SX01 hay-bale approaches with original wheel support and body contacts and actual 390px touch movement.
limitation: Public browser evidence from automated Chromium on one Mac; screenshots are browser captures, not physical-phone photos. The connected venue roster does not complete original race rules, Training objectives, hockey, weather/ambient behavior, crowd animations, water interactions, or full-game PS2 parity.
caption: Public Fury Remastered in Chromium at 390×844 portrait: Sausalito SX01 with its stadium, crowd, hay barriers, rider, and GPS reading 3 mph. Browser capture, not a physical-phone photo.
